verdict.rationale: Honeycomb docs show a single ingestion path for traces, logs, and metrics via OpenTelemetry/OTLP (honeycomb-docs-1,2,14,15,30,31), a unified Query Builder with trace-aware relational fields (root./parent./child.) enabling pivoting across signals within one query (honeycomb-docs-3,16,17,24,25), plus Kubernetes-wide log/metric/trace collection (honeycomb-docs-40) and a dedicated traces-metrics-logs getting-started guide (honeycomb-docs-12). Community evidence corroborates that logs, metrics, and traces genuinely live together in Honeycomb (honeycomb-comm-1), though the same user still stitches in external tools for full incident context, showing real-world workflows aren't always single-pane. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a single unified visualization/dashboard showing metrics+logs+traces together with one-click pivot, and stronger independent corroboration beyond one HN thread.
